build_flat_l2_index: build a faiss IndexFlatL2 index with a given dimension for exact nearest neighbor search
check_index_trained: check if a faiss index is trained using the is_trained property
add_vectors_to_index: add an array of float32 vectors to a faiss index using the add method
get_index_vector_count: get the total number of vectors stored in a faiss index using the ntotal property
search_nearest_neighbors: search a faiss index for the k nearest neighbors of query vectors using the search method
